job.subject: Application for Web Developer – 3+ Years Experience
job.emailTemplate:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Web Developer position at your organization. With over 3 years of hands-on experience in building responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to your development team.

Key Highlights of My Expertise:

Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, and Vue.js

Skilled in Node.js, RESTful APIs, and backend integration

Strong experience in responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and mobile-first development

Hands-on expertise in UI/UX tools (Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch) and converting designs into pixel-perfect code

Knowledge of performance optimization, SEO best practices, and accessibility standards (WCAG)

I am an immediate joiner, detail-oriented, and passionate about delivering modern web solutions that improve user experience and business performance.

I have attached my updated resume for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical skills and creativity can add value to your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Full Name]
[ Email] | [Phone] | [Website]
